text: A deadline has moved forward and two important tasks now compete for your attention. What would you do first, and how would you communicate the revised plan?
A colleague is unavailable during a busy handover and the notes are incomplete. What would you do to keep the work on track?
A teammate asks to postpone their part while the group must decide what to do today. How would you respond to the different needs?
A familiar team process is causing avoidable problems, but changing it requires agreement. How would you discuss and test a fair alternative?
A project plan is no longer working as expected. How would you question the assumption, explore an alternative, and evaluate it?
A handover contains conflicting notes and the usual approach is blocked. What information would you seek and what alternative would you try?
